title: Final review of the test-performance diff
description:
Review the whole epic's diff against its definition of done, outside-in.

The two questions this epic can fail on quietly, so ask them explicitly:
1. Is every defect class the suite used to catch still caught? Reintroduce the FETCH_HEAD, --refmap=, shared peek-ref and ref-lock regressions one at a time and confirm each still fails its guard. A faster suite that stopped catching them is a loss, not a win.
2. Did any durable-evidence semantics change without a tick saying so? The commit/push batching tick is allowed to change them deliberately and with its analysis recorded; nothing else is.

Then measure: time the declared gate on a quiet host and compare against the before figure recorded on the epic.
